# copyleft-next

> > A modern copyleft license project advancing free software licensing through community-driven development and GPL-compatible terms.

The Copyleft-Next Project, led by Bradley M. Kuhn and Richard E. Fontana at the Software Freedom Conservancy, develops a next-generation copyleft license addressing contemporary software distribution challenges. The project emphasizes community participation, patent protection, and compatibility with existing free software licenses.
